dict.string: Snag listens for a short voice command so it can turn what is under your cursor into a task. Audio is not saved.
Snag captures the display under your cursor so it can read what is on screen. Screenshots are not saved.
Snag reads the text under your cursor (for example a Grain transcript, Slack thread, or PR) so it can extract every action item. Text is not saved except as task notes you keep.
Snag reads the frontmost app name so the task can remember where it came from.
